laws.rule: Anglers must not release black bass or bluegill they catch back into Lake Biwa or any other water in Shiga. Put them in the non-native fish collection boxes or pens at lakeside spots and fishing ports, or kill them and take them away.
laws.heading: 滋賀県琵琶湖のレジャー利用の適正化に関する条例 (no-release rule)

laws.rule: Pleasure boats, including personal watercraft, must not enter the navigation-restricted zones of Lake Biwa set under the prefecture's Lake Biwa leisure-use ordinance (near homes, fish breeding grounds and waterbird nesting areas). Conventional two-stroke engines are also banned on the lake.
laws.heading: 琵琶湖ルール1 and 2 (pleasure boats)

laws.rule: Shiga Ordinance on the Healthy Development of Young People (滋賀県青少年の健全育成に関する条例), art. 22. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 5 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902) or a petty fine (kayo). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.

items.text: The Shiga Prefecture Ordinance on the Sound Development of Young People (滋賀県青少年の健全育成に関する条例, Ordinance No. 40 of 23 December 1977) treats a young person as someone under 18 (art. 10, 'hereinafter the same'). Article 25 forbids anyone, knowing that a listed act is being done to a young person or that a young person is doing it, from providing a place for it or arranging that place. The listed acts include drinking alcohol or smoking (art. 25(1)), as well as specified drug and solvent use (as amended by Ordinance No. 7 of 2020 and Ordinance No. 41 of 2023). A breach of article 25 is punishable by a fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707) (art. 27(2)(14)). A person cannot escape that penalty by saying they did not know the young person's age, unless there was no negligence (art. 27(5)).

The same article 25(1) place-provision and arranging ban, and the same fine of up to JPY 300,000 (about A$2,707), also covers smoking by or involving a person under 18. Separately, article 19 is only a duty of effort: people whose business is selling alcohol or tobacco from vending machines, and those who manage those machines, must try to take measures so that young people cannot buy from them. That article is not a hard ban and has no penalty of its own in the provisions read.

psychoactive-substances.notes: This prefecture ordinance regulates providing or arranging a place for someone under 18 to drink or smoke. It is not Japan's national under-20 drinking and smoking laws, which are not restated here as prefecture law. Yen converted at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = JPY 110.82).
